name: backup-assets-release-acceptance
title: 备份资产发布验收
description: v0.50.4 线上真实 Rsync 数据接入、目录/搜索/内容预览端到端验收；通过后才启动节点日志 P1。
creator: weibo
notes: Historical v0.50.2 No-Go remains in research/acceptance-protocol.md. Production is restored and healthy on v0.50.4 with schema 72|0, backup_assets enabled, an online Rsync repository, active task link, and observed mutable point. The Catalog SQLite batch-limit fix shipped in v0.50.5; the first upgrade rolled back automatically on an authoritative orphan TaskRun. Formal Cancel reconciliation shipped in v0.50.6, but the v0.50.6 post-merge main race gate exposed a second Catalog lifecycle test flake after an earlier sibling flake. Child catalog-lifecycle-race-stability owns the deterministic test-only repair and next stable release. No production SQL, no manual Catalog retry, and no further upgrade attempt before that release is fully green and published. Node-log collectors stay disabled and P1 cannot start until the real-data preview gate passes.
